arena: [우선 처치] With Necrotic Wounds, each Putrefy hit absorbs 8% of the target's healing taken for 15 sec, stacking up to 3 times. Focus Putrefy on a single kill target.
[생존기] Anti-Magic Shell absorbs magic damage and blocks harmful magic effects for 5 sec. Use it when an enemy caster sends magic CC or magic burst.
[분담] With Spellwarden you can cast Anti-Magic Shell on allies and its cooldown drops by 10 sec. Put it on your healer when magic CC is incoming.
[생존기] Icebound Fortitude makes you immune to stuns and reduces all damage taken by 30% for 8 sec. Pop it right before the enemy stun chain starts, and pop Lichborne early against fear.
[제어] Strangulate replaces Asphyxiate and silences a target up to 20 yds away for 4 sec. Put it on the enemy healer and burst with Dark Transformation meanwhile.
[차단] Mind Freeze interrupts a cast from 15 yds and locks that school for 5 sec. Save it for the enemy healer's heals.
[우선 처치] Death Grip pulls a target up to 30 yds away to you. Pull your kill target or the enemy healer out from behind a pillar into line of sight.
[제어] Blinding Sleet disorients enemies in front of you for 5 sec, then slows them by 50% for 6 sec, but damage can break it. Use it on enemy DPS your team isn't hitting.
bg: [참고] Pet classes are good at base defense. Guard the base flag with your Raise Dead pet and Death Grip enemies off the flag when they try to capture.
[우선 처치] Necrotic Wounds was picked by 39 of 40 Battleground Blitz players and absorbs up to 24% of the target's healing taken via Putrefy. Focus it on the enemy flag or orb carrier.
[위치] Wraith Walk breaks roots, increases movement speed by 70% for 4 sec and prevents slows. Use it when you're held but need to reach a base or flag carrier, and remember other actions cancel it.
[위치] Death's Advance increases movement speed by 35% for 10 sec and grants knockback immunity. Pop it near edges or cart circles so you don't get knocked off.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, use Icebound Fortitude and Anti-Magic Shell right before the burst.
[제어] Enemies disoriented by Blinding Sleet can't be knocked back. Use it on enemies trying to capture a base, but don't overlap it with your team's knockbacks.
pvpTalents: Necrotic Wounds, picked by all top 48 Solo Shuffle players and 39 of 40 Battleground Blitz players, makes Putrefy absorb 8% of the target's healing taken, stacking up to 3 times. Spellwarden, picked by 41 of 48 Solo Shuffle players, lets you cast Anti-Magic Shell on allies. Strangulate, picked by 36 of 48 Solo Shuffle and 30 of 40 Battleground Blitz players, replaces Asphyxiate with a 4 sec silence.

47476.d: Shadowy tendrils constrict an enemy's throat, silencing them for 4 sec.

Max 3 stacks. Adding a stack does not refresh the duration.

47476.d: 어둠의 촉수로 대상의 목을 졸라 4초 동안 침묵하도록 만듭니다.

49039.d: 부정의 에너지를 끌어내 10초 동안 언데드가 되어, 생기흡수가 6%만큼 증가하고 현혹과 공포, 수면에 면역이 됩니다.

221562.m: 특성 · 20 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
221562.d: 암흑 마력으로 적 대상을 지면에서 들어올리고 목을 휘감아 5초 동안 기절시킵니다.

356520.d:
부패가 적에게 피해를 입힐 때 괴저 상처를 부여해 15초 동안 받는 모든 치유 효과의 8%를 흡수합니다.

최대 3번까지 중첩됩니다. 중첩되어도 지속시간을 갱신시키지 않습니다.

410320.d: 아군에게 대마법 보호막을 시전할 수 있습니다. 또한 재사용 대기시간이 10초만큼 감소합니다.

note: There is no spec-specific PvP guide source, so these are general principles built from ability and PvP talent tooltips, actual top-player pick rates, and mode and map requirements.
